class.name: ScriptRunner
class.brief_description: Base class for script-backed process runners hosted by the engine CLI.
class.description: Extend [ScriptRunner] to implement a script entrypoint that the engine runs as a process. The engine launches the script under a live [SceneTree] main loop, passes user arguments after [code]--[/code] to [method run], and exits the process with the integer returned by [method run]. This host backs several command-first CLI surfaces, including [code]foundry project test --runner[/code] and the generated runner used by [code]foundry script eval[/code]. Async [method run] implementations are supported: the host awaits the coroutine handle and uses the completed result as the process exit code.

method.name: run
method.description: Script-dispatched entrypoint for the runner. [param args] contains the user arguments from [method OS.get_cmdline_user_args], in order. Return the desired process exit code. Async overrides are allowed. Example CLI: [codeblock] foundry --headless project test --project . --runner res://addons/foundrylib/testlib/cli/run.fs -- --path res://tests --filter inventory [/codeblock]
